 ‎PENTAGON brings ‘101010’ tour to Manila
 By Mark Carlo Sibug
 October 27, 2026
 40
 Resize 
 Small 
 Medium 
 Large 
 ‎K-pop boy group PENTAGON is bringing its 10th anniversary tour, “101010,” to Manila on Nov. 29, 2026, marking its return to the Philippines after four years.
 ‎The group announced Tuesday that Manila and Taipei, Taiwan, have been added to the tour's schedule.
 ‎‎Further details, including the concert venue and ticket prices, have yet to be announced. Local promoter Show Biz Town (SB Town) Inc. urged fans to follow its social media pages for updates.
 ‎‎“A decade of unforgettable songs, cherished memories, and a bond that only grows stronger. Now, it's time to celebrate this special milestone together,” SB Town said in a post on X.
 ‎‎The upcoming show will mark PENTAGON's first solo concert in the Philippines since its debut in 2016. The group last performed in the country at HALLYUWEEN in 2022, a Halloween-themed K-pop concert featuring fellow group KARD and P-pop boy group BGYO.

 ‎‎Formed by Cube Entertainment, PENTAGON debuted in October 2016 and rose to prominence with its hit single “Shine,” released in 2018.
 ‎‎The group originally consisted of 10 members before rapper E'Dawn, now known as Dawn, departed in 2018.
 Advertisement 
 ‎‎After members focused largely on their individual careers in recent years, PENTAGON reunited as a seven-member group for its 10th anniversary. The group released “Coward” in September, marking its first new music in nearly three years.
 ‎The anniversary comeback and tour feature Hui, Jinho, Hongseok, Shinwon, Yeo One, Kino and Wooseok. Chinese member Yan An has largely focused on his acting career in China, while Japanese rapper Yuto did not participate in the latest comeback.
 ‎The Nov. 29 concert will give Filipino fans another chance to see PENTAGON perform live as the group celebrates a decade since its debut.
